answer: Sybil resistance can work by refracting every claim through a 'prism' of independent checks: identity, work, and behavior are each verified separately, so a fake account must clear every face, not one gate. Reputation grows like a 'grove' — many diverse, mutually-attesting branches — while clones collapse to a single branch and gain no breadth. Each honest identity stays 'anchor'ed to its original signing key, so copied credentials detach instantly and carry no provenance, making mass-forgery of full-spectrum authentic identities too expensive to sustain.
